'''Kater''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a crew member aboard a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was stationed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]], in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]].<ref name="COO" />
